integrity_notes: The infinite result follows from the written proof. Finite programs cover t=1..7 only. Priority comparison is literature-based and not a proof of uniqueness; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact \(2^{t-1}\) count is within the constructed family, not all width-three posets; no claim that fifteen vertices is globally minimal; first-order signature is the strict transitive relation, not cover edges.
title: Exponential counting-logic ambiguity in width-three finite posets
